topics.title: Week 1: Thinking in React
topics.note: Components, JSX, Props, State (useState), Effects (useEffect). — Task 1: [The Static Tweet] • Build a Twitter Card component. Passing data via props. • Task 2: [Interactive Accordion]

topics.title: Week 2: Forms & Side Effects
topics.note: Controlled Components, useRef, useEffect Cleanup, Custom Hooks. — Task 1: [Registration Form] • Task 2: [Window Resizer Hook] • Create a custom hook useWindowSize() that returns width/height.

topics.title: Week 3: Data-Driven React (API & Routing)
topics.note: React Router v6, Fetching Data (useEffect vs Query), Handling Loading/Error states. — Task: [Movie Search App]

topics.title: Week 4: Global State (Redux Toolkit)
topics.note: Store, Slices, Dispatch, Selectors. — Task: [E-Commerce Cart System] • Challenge: Implement "Undo" action (remove last item).

topics.title: Week 5: Next.js Fundamentals (App Router)
topics.note: Server vs Client Components, File-based Routing, Layouts. — Task: [Simple Blog]

topics.title: Week 6: Server Actions & Databases
topics.note: Server Actions (No API routes), Prisma (ORM), Supabase/PostgreSQL. — Task: [Guestbook App] • User can sign the guestbook (Form submission without useState).

topics.title: Week 7: Authentication & Optimization
topics.note: NextAuth (Auth.js), Middleware, Image Optimization, Fonts. — Task: [Protected Dashboard]

topics.title: Week 8: The Final Capstone
topics.note: Project: [Fullstack LMS (Learning Management System)] • Teacher Mode: Create courses, upload chapters.
